pr.title: Add WHO SMART Guidelines approach figure from shared who-iris data
pr.body:
## What
- `folio/dth-hrh/media/smart-guidelines-approach.svg`: generated by `smart-approach-svg` (`litlfred/folio-assistant-core#405`) from `who-iris/library/9789240116191-eng/figure-data/fig-5-smart-guidelines-approach.json` (`litlfred/who-iris#149`).
- `folio/dth-hrh/ch03-digital-transformation-approach/f-smart-guidelines-approach.{ts,md,jsonld}`: adds `fig:smart-guidelines-approach` to Chapter 3 §3.1 (*DIIG alignment*, where `p-ch03-diig-alignment` introduces both the DIIG sequence and the SMART Guidelines approach alongside `fig:diig-phases`), recording `meta.source.generated` provenance, `meta.glossary` links (`SMART Guidelines`, `Health workforce registry`, `Interoperability`), and `meta.archimate` mappings (`smart-ra 0.2.0` `SMART Guidelines L1/L2/L3`, `DPI-H Health Workforce Registry (HWR)`, `CDS`, and `1. Central Health Workforce Registry`).
- `folio/dth-hrh/review-anchors.json`: refreshed via `bun run review:anchors`.

## Verification
- `bun run check:kg-blocks` (`gen-block-jsonld --check: 323 sibling(s) up to date`)
- `bun run check:review-anchors` (`✓ review-anchors.json is current`)
- `bun run check:dth-glossary` (`✓ ArchiMate: 68 link(s) from 23 block(s) to dpi-h-ra checked`)
- `bun run site:document` (`323 block(s)` built cleanly with 0 errors)
